section.purpose: Embedded Inter Medium; section and meter labels.

nativeEditor.reference: Clip Pocket Solid Dark supplied source
nativeEditor.scaling: Native host/OS pixel scaling; logical pixels.
nativeEditor.material: Flat dark chassis, dark recess and fine ink divider; cached RGB chassis.
nativeEditor.rendering: JUCE Graphics; no custom OpenGL context.

states.unavailable: Em dash while routing, learning or data availability is insufficient.
states.short: Three seconds of sample energies; updated every 100 ms after model learning.
states.integrated: Summed residual/output energies since reset; warm-up excluded.
states.reset: Clears Integrated and measured time; preserves Short.
states.pause: Short unavailable; Integrated preserved. New capture epoch resets Short.

nativeEditor.snapshot: Nonblocking try-lock; retain previous values if the worker owns the meter mutex.

components.name: Residual measurement panel
components.description: Compact native Short / Integrated panel; production uses JUCE font metrics. Reset sits below and clears only Integrated.

narrative.overview: Compact native music residual meter with embedded Inter, a flat dark chassis and two pale blue percentage readouts.
keyCharacteristics: Short / Integrated with Reset; no graphs or Momentary meter.
Music estimate after linear-response and 20 ms envelope compensation.
rules: No spectrum calculations; background FFT convolution remains for prediction.
Poll at 10 Hz with a nonblocking meter snapshot.
dos: Retain Clip Pocket Solid Dark and embedded Inter.
Preserve native scaling and meaningful accessible descriptions.
donts: Do not label residual as true THD, loudness or exact isolated nonlinear energy.
Do not claim independence from every compressor or transient shaper.
Do not add graphs, decorative animation or a custom OpenGL context.
